038@Category({ RegionServerTests.class, MediumTests.class })
039public class TestQuotaCache {
040
041  @ClassRule
042  public static final HBaseClassTestRule CLASS_RULE =
043    HBaseClassTestRule.forClass(TestQuotaCache.class);
044
045  private static final HBaseTestingUtil TEST_UTIL = new HBaseTestingUtil();
046  private static final int REFRESH_TIME_MS = 1000;
047
048  @AfterClass
049  public static void tearDown() throws Exception {
050    ThrottleQuotaTestUtil.clearQuotaCache(TEST_UTIL);
051    EnvironmentEdgeManager.reset();
052    TEST_UTIL.shutdownMiniCluster();
053  }
054
055  @BeforeClass
056  public static void setUpBeforeClass() throws Exception {
057    TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration().setBoolean(QuotaUtil.QUOTA_CONF_KEY, true);
058    TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration().setInt(QuotaCache.REFRESH_CONF_KEY, REFRESH_TIME_MS);
059    TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration().setInt(QuotaUtil.QUOTA_DEFAULT_USER_MACHINE_READ_NUM, 1000);
060
061    TEST_UTIL.startMiniCluster(1);
062    TEST_UTIL.waitTableAvailable(QuotaTableUtil.QUOTA_TABLE_NAME);
063  }
064
065  @Test
066  public void testDefaultUserRefreshFrequency() throws Exception {
067    QuotaCache.TEST_BLOCK_REFRESH = true;
068
069    QuotaCache quotaCache =
070      ThrottleQuotaTestUtil.getQuotaCaches(TEST_UTIL).stream().findAny().get();
071    UserGroupInformation ugi = UserGroupInformation.getCurrentUser();
072
073    UserQuotaState userQuotaState = quotaCache.getUserQuotaState(ugi);
074
075    QuotaCache.TEST_BLOCK_REFRESH = false;
076    // new user should have refreshed immediately
077    TEST_UTIL.waitFor(5_000, () -> userQuotaState.getLastUpdate() != 0);
078    long lastUpdate = userQuotaState.getLastUpdate();
079
080    // refresh should not apply to recently refreshed quota
081    quotaCache.triggerCacheRefresh();
082    Thread.sleep(250);
083    long newLastUpdate = userQuotaState.getLastUpdate();
084    assertEquals(lastUpdate, newLastUpdate);
085
086    quotaCache.triggerCacheRefresh();
087    waitMinuteQuota();
088    // should refresh after time has passed
089    TEST_UTIL.waitFor(5_000, () -> lastUpdate != userQuotaState.getLastUpdate());
090  }
091
092  @Test
093  public void testUserQuotaLookup() throws Exception {
094    QuotaCache quotaCache =
095      ThrottleQuotaTestUtil.getQuotaCaches(TEST_UTIL).stream().findAny().get();
096    final Admin admin = TEST_UTIL.getAdmin();
097    admin.setQuota(QuotaSettingsFactory.throttleUser("my_user", ThrottleType.READ_NUMBER, 3737,
098      TimeUnit.MINUTES));
099
100    // Setting a quota and then looking it up from the cache should work, even if the cache has not
101    // refreshed
102    UserGroupInformation ugi = UserGroupInformation.createRemoteUser("my_user");
103    QuotaLimiter quotaLimiter = quotaCache.getUserLimiter(ugi, TableName.valueOf("my_table"));
104    assertEquals(3737, quotaLimiter.getReadNumLimit());
105
106    // if no specific user quota, fall back to default
107    ugi = UserGroupInformation.createRemoteUser("my_user2");
108    quotaLimiter = quotaCache.getUserLimiter(ugi, TableName.valueOf("my_table"));
109    assertEquals(1000, quotaLimiter.getReadNumLimit());
110
111    // still works after refresh
112    quotaCache.forceSynchronousCacheRefresh();
113    ugi = UserGroupInformation.createRemoteUser("my_user");
114    quotaLimiter = quotaCache.getUserLimiter(ugi, TableName.valueOf("my_table"));
115    assertEquals(3737, quotaLimiter.getReadNumLimit());
116
117    ugi = UserGroupInformation.createRemoteUser("my_user2");
118    quotaLimiter = quotaCache.getUserLimiter(ugi, TableName.valueOf("my_table"));
119    assertEquals(1000, quotaLimiter.getReadNumLimit());
120  }
121
122  @Test
123  public void testTableQuotaLookup() throws Exception {
124    QuotaCache quotaCache =
125      ThrottleQuotaTestUtil.getQuotaCaches(TEST_UTIL).stream().findAny().get();
126    final Admin admin = TEST_UTIL.getAdmin();
127    admin.setQuota(QuotaSettingsFactory.throttleTable(TableName.valueOf("my_table"),
128      ThrottleType.READ_NUMBER, 3737, TimeUnit.MINUTES));
129
130    // Setting a quota and then looking it up from the cache should work, even if the cache has not
131    // refreshed
132    QuotaLimiter quotaLimiter = quotaCache.getTableLimiter(TableName.valueOf("my_table"));
133    assertEquals(3737, quotaLimiter.getReadNumLimit());
134
135    // if no specific table quota, fall back to default
136    quotaLimiter = quotaCache.getTableLimiter(TableName.valueOf("my_table2"));
137    assertEquals(Long.MAX_VALUE, quotaLimiter.getReadNumLimit());
138
139    // still works after refresh
140    quotaCache.forceSynchronousCacheRefresh();
141    quotaLimiter = quotaCache.getTableLimiter(TableName.valueOf("my_table"));
142    assertEquals(3737, quotaLimiter.getReadNumLimit());
143
144    quotaLimiter = quotaCache.getTableLimiter(TableName.valueOf("my_table2"));
145    assertEquals(Long.MAX_VALUE, quotaLimiter.getReadNumLimit());
146  }
